contract_details.delivered_phases: Phases 1–7 (M1 Users, M2 Orders, M3 Aggregation, M4 Payment, M5 Ledger delivered)
contract_details.out_of_scope_phases: M6 Inventory/DoF, M7 Market Intelligence, MFA, and Pen-testing are out of scope (Section 12 Future Phases)

meta.documentation_standard: Comprehensive Functional, Technical, and Code Implementation Specification

tenant_taxonomy.mediator: Mediator (Pembekal/Pembeli Intermediary Hub - 1st-Tier Intermediary tenants parent_id=1, 112, 113)
tenant_taxonomy.virtual_seller: Virtual Seller / Pembekal Maya (virtual_seller - quota allocation holder selling commodities)
tenant_taxonomy.virtual_buyer: Virtual Buyer / Pembeli Maya (buyer_with_quota - quota allocation holder purchasing commodities)
tenant_taxonomy.actual_seller: Actual Seller / Pembekal Fizikal (actual_supplier - physical mill, producer, or importer)
tenant_taxonomy.actual_buyer: Actual Buyer / Pembeli Fizikal (standard_buyer - downstream commercial wholesaler/retailer)

impersonation_rules.exit_button: Must dynamically display 'Kembali sebagai [Nama SuperAdmin]' / 'Return as [SuperAdmin Name]', fetching SuperAdmin's full name from database. NEVER hardcode SuperAdmin name.
impersonation_rules.sidebar_role_badge: While impersonating a tenant, the sidebar peranan badge MUST resolve to the IMPERSONATED TENANT'S OPERATIONAL ROLE (e.g. Pembekal Maya / Pembeli Maya), NOT SUPERADMIN.
impersonation_rules.impersonated_profile: Clicking My Profile & Hierarchy (/profile) under impersonation MUST render the IMPERSONATED TENANT'S PROFILE, SSM number, tenant role, and assigned Upline Master Mediator.
impersonation_rules.topbar_user_avatar: Topbar user avatar MUST display the IMPERSONATED TENANT'S NAME with an [IMPERSONATING] badge and exit return button in the dropdown.

tenant_management_table.action_buttons: All Mediator and subtenant rows MUST display uniform clean text buttons: [ Lihat ] [ Edit ] [ Gantung ].
tenant_management_table.superadmin_mediator_exclusion: Master Mediator #1 (Demo Trading Sdn Bhd), which is SuperAdmin's primary Mediator account line, MUST NOT have a Gantung (Suspend) button.

interactive_column_header_sorting.indicator: Every table column header (<th>) MUST render interactive ▲▼ up & down sort indicators.
interactive_column_header_sorting.hierarchy_preservation_rule: On hierarchical tables (/admin/tenants), sorting by column MUST pin Master Mediator parent rows (M1, M2, M3) at the top and re-sort ONLY subtenant child rows under each Master Mediator, 100% preserving parent-child hierarchy.

deposits_and_escrow_discipline.refunded_deposit_balance: Deposits with status REFUNDED MUST display active balance = RM 0.00 (with original amount shown in strikethrough).
deposits_and_escrow_discipline.movements_drilldown: Drilling down into a deposit MUST render the complete Deposit Movements Audit Trail (+ RM [Amount] Inbound, - RM [Amount] Refund Outbound, Ending Balance RM 0.00).

order_line_items_and_totals.calculated_totals: Order total amounts MUST be dynamically computed from line item inputs (Quantity × Unit Price + Quota Fees), NOT manually keyed-in values.
order_line_items_and_totals.drilldown: Every recent order line on the dashboard MUST be clickable (cursor-pointer) to drill down directly to order details.

code_robustness.nullable_user_signatures: NavigationMenuService::resolveRole(?User $user, $tenant) MUST accept nullable User to prevent 500 errors when auth state is uninitialized.
code_robustness.report_controller_defaults: ReportController methods MUST default null tenantId to 1 when TenantContextService::currentId() returns null for SuperAdmin.

functional_specifications.system_definition: KOJID is a controlled B2B food supply chain trading platform (working capital fortress) for Malaysian food intermediaries (rice, sugar, cooking oil — BERNAS/KPDNHEP-regulated commodities), featuring gated onboarding, hierarchical quota verification, deposit discipline, and double-entry operational finance tracking.

row_level_multi_tenant_isolation.concept: Every register, master table, transaction table, and ledger table explicitly contains a tenant_id column identifying the Master Tenant in whose accounting books the records reside.
row_level_multi_tenant_isolation.enforcement_mechanism: Laravel BelongsToTenant global query scope automatically injects WHERE tenant_id = {active_master_tenant_id} into all Eloquent queries, ensuring complete row-level access control and zero cross-tenant data leakage.

tenant_onboarding_and_composite_unique_k.invitation_loop: Mediator enters email address of prospective tenant and clicks Invite. System dispatches email with secure registration link.
tenant_onboarding_and_composite_unique_k.upline_assignment: Upon registering on kojid.my, inviting Mediator automatically becomes new tenant's upline (parent_id = upline_mediator_id).
tenant_onboarding_and_composite_unique_k.multi_mediator_recruitment: The same physical business entity (same SSM number) can be recruited by different Mediators into their respective ecosystems.
tenant_onboarding_and_composite_unique_k.composite_unique_index: UNIQUE KEY (ssm_registration_no, upline_mediator_id). Prevents duplicate appointment by the same mediator. FK relationships use surrogate long int PK (id).

mode_1_quota_subsidized_trading.description: Trading universe for quota-regulated subsidized commodities.
mode_1_quota_subsidized_trading.generated_contracts: 4 Contracts: Proforma PO (VS), Proforma SO (VB), Purchase Order (AS), Sales Order (AB).

mode_2_normal_commercial_trading.description: Normal commercial trades without quotas or subsidies.

role_requirements.virtual_seller_and_buyer: Upload picture of proof of subsidy/quota permit MANDATORY for QUOTA_SUBSIDIZED mode. Upload button ALWAYS VISIBLE in UI for VS and VB.
role_requirements.actual_seller_and_buyer: Proof of subsidy NOT REQUIRED. Upload button HIDDEN in UI for AS and AB.

email_like_inter_tenant_intent_mailbox.concept: Intents operate like an internal email system within KOJID with independent mailbox copies.

decision_outcomes.APPROVE: Submitter receives an UNMODIFIABLE copy flagged APPROVED and system generates official contracts.
decision_outcomes.REJECT: Submitter receives an UNMODIFIABLE copy flagged REJECTED.
decision_outcomes.RETURN_WITH_REMARKS: Submitter receives an EDITABLE copy flagged REDRAFT_REQUESTED to modify figures and resubmit.

documents.name: Proforma Purchase Order
documents.privacy: Exposes VS commission rate & amount. Hides VB/AS/AB.

documents.name: Proforma Sales Order
documents.privacy: Exposes VB commission rate & amount. Hides VS/AS/AB.

documents.name: Purchase Order (MSK)
documents.privacy: Exposes AS purchase price & qty. No commissions shown.

documents.name: Sales Order (KLR)
documents.privacy: Exposes AB sales price & qty. No commissions shown.

official_document_nomenclature_and_priva.selective_deselection_toggles: Mediator can untick any document checkbox prior to dispatch.

transaction_intent_lifecycle.internal_approval_rule: M approves intent internally. Posting status remains UNPOSTED (Zero ledger entries / Zero income recognized).

accrual_recognition_triggers.liabilities_recognition: Liabilities to AS, VS, VB raised IMMEDIATELY AND ONLY UPON COLLECTION / RECEIPT OF GOODS FROM AS.
accrual_recognition_triggers.sales_recognition: Sales revenue recognized ONLY WHEN PRODUCTS HAVE BEEN DELIVERED TO AB.

inbound_delivery_acceptance_and_partial_.broadcast_notifications: Dispatched to all active document recipients.

delivery_orders_invoices_and_immutabilit.inward_fulfillment: Inward DO (MSK-DO) and Inward Invoice (MSK-INV) with vendor_invoice_image_path.
delivery_orders_invoices_and_immutabilit.rounding_error_absorption: Final delivery batch absorbs all value rounding errors.

moving_weighted_average_costing_and_inve.concept: Moving Weighted Average Costing (AVCO / MAC). Table includes balance_qty, balance_value, and weighted_avg_cost.

shipment_pl_statement_architecture.pl_chain: Sales Revenue -> COGS (AVCO) -> Gross Trading Profit -> OpEx -> Net Operating Income -> Quota Fees -> Net Mediator Shipment Profit.

star_topology_deposit_architecture.routing_rule: All deposits route through Mediator. Direct sub-tenant deposits prohibited.
star_topology_deposit_architecture.withdrawal_buffer_formula: Max Withdrawal = Deposit Balance - Realised Liabilities - Unrealised Pending Order Liabilities.
star_topology_deposit_architecture.statement_rule: Itemized statements include BOTH verified and unverified entries.

full_fledged_cashbook_and_bank_reconcili.cashbook_scope: Supports trade and non-trade cash transactions (rent, utilities, salaries, taxes, bank charges, inter-bank transfers).
full_fledged_cashbook_and_bank_reconcili.formula: Balance per Bank Statement = Balance per Cashbook + Unpresented Payments - Uncredited Deposits

immutable_price_history_architecture.concept: Historical prices saved in merchandise_price_histories. Old prices are IMMUTABLE. Latest active entry applies.

strict_ledger_immutability_and_correctiv.concept: Once posted, entries are 100% immutable. Adjustments require Credit Notes (CN), Debit Notes (DN), or Reversals.

quantum_actor_model.concept: Business entities hold dynamic transactional roles (supplier, buyer, quota_holder, intermediary).

database_schema_and_migrations.master_tenant_isolation_column: tenant_id (Compulsory Foreign Key across ALL tables)

database_triggers.action: SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Ledger entries are immutable and cannot be updated.'
SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Ledger entries are immutable and cannot be deleted.'
